title: Iron Age kit (stone houses, town walls, gatehouse, market, temple, academy)
licence: original (procedural geometry and textures, no external inputs)
units: metres (1 Blender unit = 1 m), Z up, front -Y, pivot at footprint centre on the ground; foundations reach 0.3-1.2 m below Z=0
material_slots: exactly 3 on every mesh, state and LOD, in the order Structure, Roof, Detail (index 0, 1, 2); a slot may carry no faces (ruins have no roof, props use only Detail): see slots_with_faces
vertex_colour: Col (RGB): baked grime/occlusion and scorch multiplier for base colour (1 = clean)

lods.note: LOD3 (massing hull) on every building and wall piece, props stop at LOD2; FBX holds an LodGroup with children _LOD0.._LODn

cultures.C: Ring-Builder (pale stone, blue-grey slate roofs via texture override)

M_Age2_Trim.notes: trim sheet: horizontal bands tile in U only (2.0 m per U); M.R = night-window emissive mask

House_A.description: Small rubble-stone cottage with a steep reed-thatch gable roof and a stone chimney.

House_B.description: Stone longhouse with a dark split-shingle roof, a shingled door porch and a central chimney.
House_B.maps_to: EDmTownMesh::Cottage (Age 2, long) / Longhouse replacement in Age 2

House_C.description: Two-storey house: rubble ground floor, jettied timber-framed lime-plaster upper floor, shingle roof gable-end to the street.
House_C.maps_to: EDmTownMesh::Cottage (Age 2, two storeys); town cores, tier >= 2

House_D.description: Farmstead: thatched hip-roofed hall, thatched back wing, low walled yard and a woodshed.
House_D.maps_to: EDmTownMesh::Cottage (Age 2, farmstead); town edges and villages

WallSeg.description: 16 m town-wall unit: 3.2 m thick, 7.6 m walkway, crenellated outer parapet, battered base; tiles along X.
WallSeg.maps_to: EDmTownMesh::WallSeg variant 1 (Iron); same 16 m unit along X, outer face -Y, planner scales X

WallTower_A.description: 9 x 9 m hollow square wall tower, 15 m, crenellated top, arrow slits, doors to the wall walk.

WallTower_B.description: 9 x 9 m square wall tower with timber hoarding on corbels and a pyramidal clay-tile roof.
WallTower_B.maps_to: EDmTownMesh::WallTower variant 1 alternate (hoarded, roofed) - mix 1 in 3, or for Age 2 culture variety

Gatehouse.description: Twin-tower gatehouse: round-arched passage with portcullis and open gate leaves, timber gallery roof, hoarded towers.
Gatehouse.maps_to: EDmTownMesh::Gatehouse variant 1 (Iron); road along Y through the arch

Market.description: Colonnaded market square: clay-tiled galleries on timber posts round a paved court, striped-awning stalls, round fountain.

Temple.description: Peripteral stone temple, 6 x 11 columns on a three-step stylobate, pale stone-slab roof with pediments, altar in front.

Academy.description: Cloistered limestone quadrangle with slate roofs, garden court with an armillary sphere, columned porch and a verdigris-domed observatory tower.

MarketStall_A.description: Market stall: counter on four posts under a madder-striped gable awning.
MarketStall_A.maps_to: market dressing / scatter prop (gable awning stall)

MarketStall_B.description: Market stall: lean-to ochre-striped canopy over a counter with a back board and baskets.
MarketStall_B.maps_to: market dressing / scatter prop (lean-to canopy stall)

MarketStall_C.description: Market stall: two-wheeled hand cart with an indigo-striped flat canopy.

Ornament_A.description: Ridge finial, Cliff-Terrace culture: plaster dome with a cobalt knob.
Ornament_A.maps_to: culture A (Cliff-Terrace) ridge ornament: attach at each house ridge end (manifest ridge_ends)

Ornament_B.description: Ridge horn, Lagoon-Weaver culture: upswept carved timber horn with a saffron ribbon.
Ornament_B.maps_to: culture B (Lagoon-Weaver) ridge ornament: attach at each ridge end, local -Y pointing outward along the ridge

Ornament_C.description: Ridge finial, Ring-Builder culture: pale stone ring on a short post.
Ornament_C.maps_to: culture C (Ring-Builder) ridge ornament: attach at each ridge end
